description: This file defines the RemoteTunnelManager actor responsible for managing SSH tunnels, including establishing, checking, and terminating SSH tunnel processes for remote gateway/control port forwarding in a macOS application.

classes.name: RemoteTunnelManager
classes.description: An actor that manages SSH tunnel lifecycle, ensuring secure remote connectivity for the app.

methods.name: controlTunnelPortIfRunning
methods.description: Checks if an SSH tunnel is already active and returns its local port if available.

methods.name: ensureControlTunnel
methods.description: Establishes an SSH tunnel if none exists, returning the local port used for control.

methods.name: stopAll
methods.description: Terminates all active SSH tunnels managed by this class.

methods.name: isSshProcess
methods.description: Detects whether a given process descriptor corresponds to an SSH process.

methods.name: beginRestart
methods.description: Initiates a controlled restart of the SSH tunnel with backoff handling.

methods.name: endRestart
methods.description: Marks the end of a restart process.

methods.name: waitForRestartBackoffIfNeeded
methods.description: Applies backoff delay before attempting to restart SSH tunnel if needed.
